overview: Brick-built, slightly chibi minifigure statue of the character in the reference: white outfit with tan/gold leg markings and a blue lightsaber held across the chest. Target ~18–22 studs tall, sturdy and simple, using mostly white and light bluish gray with small tan/dark red accents.

subassemblies.name: Display base
subassemblies.description: Small pedestal to stabilize the model; mostly dark bluish gray/light bluish gray plates with a simple footprint (about 8x8 or 8x10). Add a couple studs on top to lock the feet in place.
subassemblies.image_location: Bottom of the image (under both feet)

subassemblies.name: Left leg + foot
subassemblies.description: Blocky leg built from stacked bricks (white primary). Add tan/gold accent striping on the shin/outer side using tan plates/tiles to suggest the printed markings. Build a large, simple foot (white) that plugs into the base.
subassemblies.image_location: Lower left of the figure (viewer’s left leg)

subassemblies.name: Right leg + foot
subassemblies.description: Mirror of the left leg. Keep hips wide enough to support the torso. Repeat tan/gold accent striping for symmetry.
subassemblies.image_location: Lower right of the figure (viewer’s right leg)

subassemblies.name: Hips/waist + belt
subassemblies.description: A 4–6 stud wide waist block connecting both legs. Add a dark red/brown belt band wrapping around using dark red and reddish brown plates/tiles; include a small front buckle/pouch suggestion with a 1x1/1x2 detail.

subassemblies.name: Torso/chest (white tunic)
subassemblies.description: Main body block in white. Use a few black or dark pieces as tiny “crease”/V-neck hints (sparingly). Slightly taper the torso by stepping plates/tiles to feel minifigure-like.

subassemblies.name: Left arm (white sleeve) + hand
subassemblies.description: Simple articulated-looking arm built as a rectangular beam in white, angled inward to meet the saber grip. End with a tan/medium nougat hand block (small) to read as skin tone.
subassemblies.image_location: Upper left side of torso (viewer’s left arm crossing inward)

subassemblies.name: Right arm (white sleeve) + hand
subassemblies.description: Mirror of left arm, positioned to hold the lightsaber with both hands. Reinforce the shoulder connection with plates so the arm doesn’t sag.
subassemblies.image_location: Upper right side of torso (viewer’s right arm crossing inward)

subassemblies.name: Neck bracket + head core
subassemblies.description: A compact neck/connector stack (light bluish gray/white) that centers the head and resists rotation. Head is a tan/medium nougat block, slightly rounded by stepping plates.

subassemblies.name: Face detailing
subassemblies.description: Minimal face: dark tiles/plates for eyes and brows, a small dark line for mouth. Keep it iconic rather than photoreal; use 1x1 elements to place features cleanly on the front of the head.
subassemblies.image_location: Front of head (upper center of image)

subassemblies.name: Hair (blond) cap
subassemblies.description: Layered “helmet” of tan/bright light yellow pieces built as a rounded cap over the head, with a slight forward fringe. Use slopes/curved bricks if available; otherwise stepped plates to suggest strands.
subassemblies.image_location: Very top of the figure (blond hair)

notes: Color blocking: prioritize White for outfit; Light Bluish Gray/Dark Bluish Gray for internal structure and saber hilt; Tan/Bright Light Yellow for hair; Dark Red/Reddish Brown for belt; Trans-light/clear blue substitute for blade using TransClear/TransLightBlue-like parts you have (e.g., TransClear/MediumAzure/Trans pieces) to read as a blue saber.
Keep the model buildable with your inventory by using standard bricks (3001/3003/3004/3005) for structure and plates (3020/3021/3022/3023/3024) for shaping and accents.
Stability tip: lock legs to hips with overlapping plates, and run a small internal spine (light bluish gray bricks) from hips up into torso/head.

Saber: build hilt as a short gray cylinder/stack (round parts if present; otherwise 1x1/1x2 light bluish gray elements) and blade as a thin vertical strip of trans/blue elements; anchor the hilt into both hands for strength.
Arms should be mechanically supported by the torso (small ledges/plates) since the pose is held across the chest.
